title: Extract ReportDir class from Python legacy report library
description: Brownfield Python refactor: extract a ReportDir class from the report_gen module's free functions. Keep free functions as wrappers.

task_spec.prompt:
Refactor src/report_gen.py to extract a ReportDir class. All 5 existing tests must still pass.

  class ReportDir:
      def __init__(self, base_dir: str, name: str) -> None
        — stores base_dir and name; does NOT create the directory immediately
      def ensure(self) -> str
        — creates the subdirectory (base_dir/name) if it does not exist
        — returns the full path as a string
      def write_html(self, title: str, rows: list[list[str]]) -> str
        — calls self.ensure() to get the dir path
        — writes report.html with the given title and rows
        — returns the full path to report.html
      def read(self) -> str
        — reads base_dir/name/report.html; returns empty string if missing
      def delete(self) -> bool
        — removes base_dir/name/report.html; returns True if deleted, False if missing

Keep the existing free functions (ensure_report_dir, write_html_report, read_report,
list_reports, delete_report) as thin wrappers that delegate to ReportDir.
All 5 existing tests must still pass.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: ReportDir class defined with __init__, ensure, write_html, read, delete methods
ensure() creates base_dir/name and returns full path
write_html() creates report.html with correct HTML
read() returns empty string for missing file
delete() returns True/False based on file existence
success_criteria: uv run ruff check src/ passes
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to confirm no regressions from your refactor. Also review the code you changed — any remaining duplication, long functions, or unclear names to clean up?
Final pass: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and confirm everything is green. Give me a one-line summary of what changed.
